findings.claim: The serializer makes destination and attempts required, but browsers do not send them, and one invalid report rejects the whole batch.

verifier.reason: `destination` and `attempts` are declared without `required=False` at src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py:43-44, and the loop at lines 108-118 returns 422 on the first invalid report before any metric is recorded. That browsers omit these fields is not provable from the repo; it rests on the W3C Reporting API serialisation (only age, type, url, user_agent, body), which the tests do not contradict since they only use hand-built payloads.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
